name: grid-cards
css: #tpl-grid-cards { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 0 9%; background: #0a0a1a; } #tpl-grid-cards .gc-heading { font-size: 54px; font-weight: 700; color: #ffffff; margin-bottom: 46px; } #tpl-grid-cards .gc-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 26px; } #tpl-grid-cards .gc-card { background: rgba(109, 139, 255, 0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(109, 139, 255, 0.3); border-radius: 16px; padding: 30px 34px; font-size: 30px; color: #c8d4ff; }
